# Instrument-response reference data

The `geonet`, `geofon`, and `earthscope` fixtures contain 2048 samples from the
public records downloaded on 2026-10-03 and their original StationXML responses.
The JSON trace identifiers and timestamps identify the exact records. They test
acceleration sensors, velocity sensors, symmetric FIR decimation chains, and an
asymmetric FIR with timing correction.

- GeoNet `NZ.WTMC.20.HN1`, 2016-11-13: https://service.geonet.org.nz/fdsnws/
- GEOFON `GE.APE..BHN`, 2023-02-06: https://geofon.gfz.de/fdsnws/
- EarthScope `IU.ANMO.00.BHZ`, 2010-02-27: https://service.earthscope.org/fdsnws/

Expected complex responses and corrected acceleration were generated by ObsPy
`Response.get_evalresp_response_for_frequencies(output='ACC')` and
`Trace.remove_response(output='ACC', water_level=None, zero_mean=True,
taper=True, taper_fraction=0.05, pre_filt=[0.02,0.05,0.3*fs,0.4*fs])`.
2048 input points use a 4096-point FFT. These golden outputs are independent of
the JavaScript implementation; tests run without Python, network, or npm.

`synthetic` is an independently evaluated artificial StationXML chain, with
analog Hertz poles/zeros, digital IIR coefficients, asymmetric FIR timing
correction, digital poles/zeros, and centimeter-per-second input units.
